x-e-e4-01.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
x-e-e4-01.goal: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.
x-e-e4-01.material:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
x-e-e4-01.thinking.0: Tụnyere oge dị n'ndetu na ókè oge a tụrụ aro, otu n'otu
x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Kpebie ma 'ókè' oge na otu oge na-adabere
x-e-e4-01.thinking.2: Gwa ya n'asụsụ Bekee, na-enye ihe akaebe gị
x-e-e4-01.prereq.0: Ihe p.m. pụtara na ịgụ oge (dị ka 3:30 na 4:00)
x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Okwu dị mfe dị ka piano class na trash
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị niile nke ndetu na-adabere n'oge na aro Jisu (4:15-5:15).
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ihe na-ewe oge, dị ka klaasị, chọpụta oge ha na-agwụ.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Tụnyere ma oge ị na-alọta ụlọ bụ tupu 4:15 ma ọ bụ mgbe ya.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Chọpụta oge klaasị na-amalite na oge ọ na-agwụ, ma tinye ya n'akụkụ oge ogige.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: Echere m ya dị ka ilele ma otu oge dabara n'ime ókè oge ogige.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Tụnyere ma oge nri abalị bụ mgbe oge ogige gwụchara.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Zaghachi Jisu n'ahịrị okwu Bekee abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ. Chọta ihe kpatara n'ndetu i ji apụghị ịga, dee ha, ma tụọ aro otu oge ọzọ na-arụ ọrụ.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ, kwuo mba n'otu ahịrị okwu site na 'Sorry, I can't ...'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dee atụmatụ abụọ na-adabere n'ndetu na oge ha, ma n'ọgwụgwụ mee aro gị site na 'Can we play at ...?'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nyere ma ihe kpatara abụọ, piano na ịtụpụ ahịhịa?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị tụrụ aro oge dị iche, ma oge ahụ anaghị adabere n'atụmatụ dị n'ndetu?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: E nwere nkebiokwu ịjụ dị ka 'I can't'?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Nzaghachi dị mma nke tụrụ aro oge dị ka ókè.

x-e-e4-02.title: Kpebie oge ịga ije nkịta na ọrụ ụlọ
x-e-e4-02.goal: Mee ọtụtụ njikọta dị iche iche nke oge ije na oge ọrụ ụlọ na-ezute ọnọdụ niile dị n'ndetu Papa.
x-e-e4-02.material:
"Ndetu Papa hapụrụ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

N'okpuru, dee oge ọ bụla dị ka 'ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.'. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 4:30, dee 30, ma ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 5:15, dee 75."
x-e-e4-02.thinking.0: Mee azịza na-ezute ọtụtụ ọnọdụ n'otu oge n'onwe gị
x-e-e4-02.thinking.1: Gbakwunye oge ọ na-ewe na oge mmalite iji lelee oge njedebe
x-e-e4-02.thinking.2: Lelee ma ha na-adabere n'ibe ha
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Okwu dị mfe dị ka walk the dog na homework
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na Mina malite ọrụ ụlọ na 5:00 na ije na 5:30, kedu ọnọdụ dị n'ndetu ka ọ na-agbaji?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Gbakwunye oge ọ na-ewe (n'nkeji) na oge mmalite nke ọrụ ọ bụla iji chọta oge ọ na-agwụ.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Se ókè oge nke ọrụ abụọ ahụ n'akụkụ ibe ha n'otu ahịrị.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.a: Tụnyere ma oge mmalite ije 5:30 bụ tupu 5:00 ma ọ bụ mgbe ya.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Tinye ọrụ ụlọ 5:00-6:00 na ije 5:30-6:00 n'akụkụ ibe ha n'ahịrị oge.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Chọta oge njedebe nke ọrụ abụọ ahụ site n'ịgbakwunye oge nke ọ bụla na-ewe na oge mmalite ya.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ọnọdụ gbasara ogologo oge ọrụ na-ewe, ọ bụghị oge mmalite.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Ọrụ ụlọ bụ 5:00-6:00 ma ije bụ 5:30-6:00, ya mere ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-adabere site na 5:30 ruo 6:00. Ije na-amalite mgbe 5:00 ma abụọ na-agwụ tupu 6:30, ya mere a na-edebe ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Mee atụmatụ dị iche iche 3 na-edebe ọnọdụ niile dị n'ndetu. w bụ mmalite ije ma k bụ mmalite ọrụ ụlọ (ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kpebie ókè w nwere ike ịbụ maka mmalite ije, wee họrọ mmalite ọrụ ụlọ k ka ọ zere oge ije ahụ.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Chọta oge njedebe site na mmalite nke ọrụ ọ bụla gbakwunyere oge ọ na-ewe, ma lelee ma ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-adabere.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Oge ahụ dị n'udi ziri ezi.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Dee w na k dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu (nkeji) nke 0 ma ọ bụ karịa.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Ije ma ọ bụ ọrụ ụlọ na-agwụ mgbe 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Oge ije na ọrụ ụlọ na-adabere.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Ije ga-amalite n'etiti nkeji 60 na 120 (5:00-6:00), ma ọrụ ụlọ ga-amalite n'ime nkeji 90 (ruo 5:30). N'ime ha, njikọta ndị na-adabereghị bụ azịza. Ihe atụ: (ije 60, ọrụ ụlọ 0), (ije 90, ọrụ ụlọ 0), (ije 60, ọrụ ụlọ 90).

x-e-e4-03.title: Ozi ederede Ken: gụọ ya ahịrị n'ahịrị ma chee mmetụta ya
x-e-e4-03.goal: Oge ọ bụla ị gụrụ otu ahịrị nke ozi ederede, chee ọzọ ihe enyi gị chọrọ, ma gbanwee echiche gị gara aga site n'ihe ngosi ọhụrụ.
x-e-e4-03.material: Enyi gị Ken na-eziga ozi ederede. A ga-egosi ya otu ibe n'otu oge. Maka ibe ọ bụla, chee ihe Ken chọrọ site na gị.
x-e-e4-03.thinking.0: Gbanwee echiche gị oge ọ bụla ihe ngosi na-abawanye
x-e-e4-03.thinking.1: Mara na otu ahịrị okwu naanị ezughị iji kwuo
x-e-e4-03.thinking.2: Dee nzaghachi Bekee site n'iji ihe kpatara (ihe ngosi) dị ka ihe akaebe
x-e-e4-03.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dị ka cold na camp
x-e-e4-03.prereq.1: Ihe 'play a game' na 'at home' pụtara
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.prompt: Gụọ ederede Ken otu akụkụ n’otu oge, oge ọ bụla chee ihe Ken chọrọ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Chọta otu okwu ma ọ bụ nọmba ọhụrụ n’akụkụ a.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tulee amụma mbụ gị na ihe ngosi ọhụrụ otu otu, hụ ma ọ ka dabara ha niile.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Họrọ amụma niile nwere ezi uche banyere ihe Ken chọrọ site n’otu ahịrị a naanị.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ị pụghị ịma kpọmkwem site n’otu ahịrị naanị. Ọ pụrụ ịbụ na ọ na-akọ akụkọ, ma ọ bụ na ọ na-arịọ ka unu gwuo egwu ọnụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ọ chọrọ ịkọrọ m ozi na o nwere egwuregwu ọhụrụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ịkọ akụkọ naanị ya bụkwa otu nkọwa nwere ike ịbụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ọ dịghị ihe kwuru gbasara ire ere.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: O yiri ka ọ na-achọ ịrịọ m ka anyị gwuo egwuregwu ahụ ọnụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: O nwere ike ịchọ ime ya ọnụ. Ugbu a ihe ngosi ahụ ka na-eme ka amụma a ghara isi ike.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Leekwa ihe ngosi ọhụrụ, buru amụma ọzọ ihe Ken chọrọ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ijikọta “egwuregwu mmadụ abụọ” na “nwanne ya nwoke gara kamp,” nkọwa kacha eke bụ na ọ na-achọ onye ya na ya ga-egwu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: O yiri ka ọ na-ewere m dịka onye nke abụọ ga-eso ya gwuo egwuregwu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ma ihe ngosi “egwuregwu mmadụ abụọ” na nke “ọ nweghị nwanne nwoke” na-akwado amụma a.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ọ chọrọ igwu egwuregwu naanị ya.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Nke a adabaghị ihe ngosi “mmadụ abụọ.”
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ ka chọrọ naanị ịkọrọ m ozi ahụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: O kwere omume site n’ahịrị mbụ, ma ugbu a e tinyela ihe ngosi na o nweghị onye ya na ya ga-egwu, nkọwa a akọwaghịzi ihe ngosi niile.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Leekwa ihe ngosi ikpeazụ, chee ọzọ ihe Ken chọrọ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ọ bụrụ na i buru ụzọ chee “ka anyị gwuo ọnụ,” ugbu a ị ga-agbanwe ya site na “taa” gaa “mgbe e mesịrị.” Otu ihe ngosi ọhụrụ (oyi, okwu mama) gbanwere atụmatụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ọ na-arịọ m ka m bịa n’ụlọ ya taa ka anyị gwuo ọnụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Nke a adabaghị ihe ngosi na mama ya kwuru na ndị enyi agaghị abịa n’ụlọ taa.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ọ chọghịzi ka mụ na ya gwuo egwu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: O nyere ihe kpatara ịsị mba (oyi, okwu mama), o nweghịkwa ihe ngosi na ọ chọghị igwu egwu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ọ chọrọ ka unu gwuo ọnụ mgbe ahụ́ ya dị mma.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Oyi bụ ihe kpatara ya; nke a pụtara na unu ga-enwe ike ime ya mgbe oyi ahụ gwụrụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.reflect: N’ime amụma atọ gị, nke gbanwere nke ukwuu? Kwuo otu ahịrịokwu kpatara ya.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaa Ken n’otu ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu Bekee abụọ. Gosi na ị ghọtara ihe Ken chọrọ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee otu ahịrịokwu gbasara ahụ́ Ken.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.1: N’ahịrịokwu nke abụọ, tụọ aro oge unu ga-ejikọ gwuo egwuregwu ahụ.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ: Get well soon, Ken! ...
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nabatara ozi gbasara oyi Ken ma ọ bụ tụọ aro ime ya mgbe e mesịrị?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị zaghachiri ihe gbasara egwuregwu Ken?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: E nwere ihe na-adabaghị ihe ngosi gara aga, dịka ikwu na ị ga-aga n’ụlọ ya taa?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza tụrụ aro otu oge kpọmkwem.

x-e-e4-04.title: Gịnị ka email Sora na-arịọ?
x-e-e4-04.goal: Kpebie ebumnuche onye dere email dị mkpirikpi, nye ihe akaebe, zaa n’asụsụ Bekee ka ọ dabara ebumnuche ahụ.
x-e-e4-04.material:
Email Sora zigara onye nkuzi ya (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Dear Ms. Park,
I am sorry. I forgot my homework at home. My mom can bring it to school at 11 a.m. today. Is that OK?
Sora

Enyi atọ kwuru ihe Sora chọrọ.
x-e-e4-04.thinking.0: Ịhọrọ nkwupụta nwere ihe akaebe ka mma n’etiti nkwupụta dị iche iche
x-e-e4-04.thinking.2: Ịza ka o kwekọọ na ebumnuche
x-e-e4-04.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dịka homework na bring
x-e-e4-04.prereq.1: Na “Is that OK?” bụ ụzọ isi rịọ ikike
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.prompt: Nkọwa onye dabara ahịrịokwu email kacha?
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tulee nkọwa atọ ahụ na ahịrị email otu otu, chọta okwu ndị na-emegide ha.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Dee ihe “bring,” “today,” na “Is that OK?” nke ọ bụla na-egosi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.a: Lelee ma email kwuru na ọ ga-ebute homework.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.b: Lelee okwu dị na email: today ka ọ bụ tomorrow?
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.c: Hana: “Sora na-ajụ ma ọ ga-ekwe omume inyefe homework ya n’ụtụtụ a.”
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.c: Lelee ihe “11 a.m. today” na “Is that OK?” na-egosi mgbe e jikọtara ha.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.explain: “My mom can bring it ... at 11 a.m. today” na-ekwu na ọ ga-ebute homework n’elekere 11 nke ụtụtụ taa; “Is that OK?” na-ajụ ma ọ dị mma. O nweghị okwu gbasara ịghara inyefe ya, o nweghịkwa arịrịọ oge ruo echi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.prompt: Were ọrụ Ms. Park, zaa Sora n’otu ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu Bekee abụọ. Zaa ajụjụ Sora.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ zaa ajụjụ Sora site na “Yes” ma ọ bụ “No.”
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.1: N’ahịrịokwu nke abụọ, dee mgbe na onye ọ ga-enye homework.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị zara ajụjụ Sora (Is that OK?)?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị dere oge ma ọ bụ ụzọ e si eweta homework ka ọ dabara email?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ọ bụrụ na azịza gị enyeghị ikike, ị dere ihe kpatara ya?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza nyere ikike ma tinyekwa ncheta maka oge ọzọ.

x-e-e4-05.title: Aga m Movie Day?
x-e-e4-05.goal: Kewaa ozi achọrọ iji kpebie na nke na-adịghị, site n’ozi ị nwetara kpebie ma ị ga-aga.
x-e-e4-05.material:
Ozi e dere n’elu bọọdụ ụlọ akwụkwọ (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Movie Day
Friday, after school
Come and watch a movie in the gym.
Bring a snack.

Ọnọdụ Mina: Friday ọ ga-anọrịrị n’ụlọ tupu 6:00 p.m.; ọ na-ewe nkeji 20 iji ụkwụ si ụlọ akwụkwọ ruo n’ụlọ. Ego ọ ga-emefu bụ 1,000 won.
x-e-e4-05.thinking.0: Tulee ọnọdụ nke m, họrọ ozi a chọrọ n’ezie
x-e-e4-05.thinking.1: Lelee ma ozi ị nwetara mezuru ọnọdụ niile
x-e-e4-05.thinking.2: Ịmata ozi na-atọ ụtọ na ozi achọrọ
x-e-e4-05.prereq.1: Okwu dị mfe dịka ticket, movie, na snack
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ozi niile Mina ga-ajụ onye nkuzi ka o kpebie ma ọ ga-aga.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ọnọdụ abụọ Mina nwere, chọta ozi na-efu n’ọkwa ahụ.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ajụjụ nke ọ bụla, chee ma azịza ya nwere ike ịgbanwe mkpebi “aga/agaghị aga.”
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.a: Ozi na-amasị gị ịmata na ozi achọrọ iji kpebie dị iche. Chee ma ị ga-enyocha oge na ego ọbụna n’enweghị ozi a.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ozi metụtara ọnọdụ oge Mina.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ozi metụtara ọnọdụ ego Mina.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọkwa ahụ ekwuolarị “Bring a snack.” Chee ma azịza a na-agbanwe ma ọ ga-aga.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.explain: Mina nwere ọnọdụ abụọ, “ịlaghachi n’ụlọ tupu 6” na “1,000 won”; ya mere ọ pụrụ ikpebi naanị mgbe ọ matara oge ihe nkiri ga-agwụ na ọnụ ahịa ticket. Aha ihe nkiri na snack bụ ihe mmadụ nwere ike ịchọ ịma, ma ha anaghị agbanwe mkpebi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.prompt: Onye nkuzi zara, “Ihe nkiri ahụ ga-agwụ na 5:30 p.m. Ticket bụ 1,500 won.” Gịnị ka Mina kwesịrị ime?
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Lelee ọnọdụ abụọ iche iche otu otu.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye oge i ji ụkwụ aga na oge ihe nkiri gwụsịrị iji lelee ọnọdụ oge.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.a: Ego na oge abụọ ahụ dabara, ya mere ọ pụrụ ịga.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.a: Ị tụnyere ọnọdụ ego na ọnụ ahịa ticket e nyere?
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.b: Mgbe ihe nkiri gwụrụ ọ ga-anọ n’azụ oge, ọ gaghị eru n’ụlọ tupu 6.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.b: Tinye nkeji 20 nke i ji eje ije na 5:30, tulee ya na 6:00.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.c: Oge dabara, ma ego ya ezughị.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.c: Echiche a nyochara ọnọdụ abụọ iche iche.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.explain: Ọ na-agwụ na 5:30; mgbe njem ụkwụ nkeji 20 gasịrị ọ ga-eru n’ụlọ na 5:50, tupu 6:00. Ma ticket bụ 1,500 won, ya mere ọ gaghị eji 1,000 won zụta ya. A ga-enyocha ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ.

x-e-e4-06.title: Gịnị ka m ga-ajụ Ben?
x-e-e4-06.goal: Chọta ozi na-efu n’atụmatụ, mepụta ajụjụ Bekee abụọ n’onwe gị iji nweta ya.
x-e-e4-06.material:
Ben zitere Mina ozi: “Ka anyị rụọ homework sayensị ọnụ na Saturday. Bịa n’ụlọ m!”

Ọnọdụ Mina: Ben kwagara n’ụlọ ọhụrụ, Mina amaghị ebe ụlọ ọhụrụ ahụ dị. Mina nwere klaasị igwu mmiri na Saturday site na 10 a.m. ruo 11 a.m.
x-e-e4-06.thinking.0: Ikewapụ ozi na-efu na nke ị maralarị
x-e-e4-06.thinking.2: Ide ajụjụ na-egosipụta ọnọdụ nke m
x-e-e4-06.prereq.0: Ịmepụta ajụjụ what time, where, na how
x-e-e4-06.prereq.1: Ịgụ ahịrịokwu dị mkpirikpi nke ederede
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.prompt: Iji mee atụmatụ, họrọ ozi niile Mina ga-ajụ Ben.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.hint.0: Dee iche ozi dị n’ozi Ben na nke na-adịghị n’ime ya.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.hint.1: Site n’ọnọdụ abụọ Mina nwere, chọta ihe ọ ka na-amaghị.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.a: Nke a metụtara usoro ọrụ Mina na Saturday.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma ihe ahụ masịrị gị ịmata, chee ma ọ bụ ozi achọrọ iji mee atụmatụ.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.o.c: Otu esi aga n’ụlọ ọhụrụ Ben, ma ọ bụ adreesị ya
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.c: Nke a metụtara ihe Mina ka na-amaghị n’ọnọdụ ya.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.d: Isiokwu ahụ adịlarị n’ozi Ben. Lelee ma ọ dị mkpa ịchọpụta ya ọzọ.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.explain: E nweghị oge, ya mere ọ gaghị ama ma ọ na-adakọ klaasị igwu mmiri; ọ maghịkwa ebe ụlọ ọhụrụ ahụ dị, ya mere ọ gaghị aga. Isiokwu homework (science) dị n’ozi ahụ, nri ụtụtụ enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na atụmatụ.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.prompt: Dee ajụjụ Bekee abụọ ị ga-ezigara Ben. Otu ga-abụ maka oge, nke ọzọ maka ebe.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ họrọ mkpụrụokwu ajụjụ. Ajụjụ oge nwere ike ịmalite na What time, ajụjụ ebe na Where ma ọ bụ How.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye akara ajụjụ (?) na njedebe ajụjụ nke ọ bụla, chee ma ị pụrụ ịkọwa oge kpọmkwem n’ihi klaasị igwu mmiri.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Otu ajụjụ ọ̀ gbasara oge, nke ọzọ banyere ebe?
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: N’ihi klaasị igwu mmiri m (10-11), enwere m ike ime ka ajụjụ oge doo anya karị?
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị tinyere akara ajụjụ na njedebe ahịrịokwu?
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ajụjụ kpọmkwem nke na-egosipụta klaasị igwu mmiri.

x-e-e4-07.title: Ụlọ akwụkwọ abụọ, otu ahịrịokwu
x-e-e4-07.goal: Chọta ahịrịokwu kpatara nghọtahie, degharịa ya n’asụsụ Bekee ka o nye otu ihe ahụ n’enweghị nghọtahie.
x-e-e4-07.material: Nke a bụ akụkọ Jisu na Ben. E nwere ụlọ akwụkwọ abụọ n’obodo a. Otu bụ City Library dị n’akụkụ ogige, nke ọzọ bụ ụlọ akwụkwọ library dị n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ. Na Saturday ụlọ akwụkwọ library emechiri. N’ahịrị ndị a, otu ahịrịokwu kpatara nghọtahie.
x-e-e4-07.thinking.1: Chọpụta ozi na-efu (ụlọ akwụkwọ library nke a)
x-e-e4-07.thinking.2: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu e degharịrị tinyere ozi ọhụrụ
x-e-e4-07.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dịka library, school, na park
x-e-e4-07.prereq.1: Ịhọrọ ebe ka ahịrị nke nwere okwu mere enyi abụọ ahụ ghara izute?
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.prompt: Lelee ahịrị 3 na 4: ebe Jisu na Ben nọ n’otu n’otu.
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.hint.0: Chọta ahịrị nwere okwu mere ha ji chee ebe dị iche iche. [3, 4]
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.hint.1: “The library” dị n’ahịrị 1 anaghị agwa gị ma ọ bụ City Library ka ọ bụ school library. Ụtọ asụsụ ziri ezi, ma ebe ahụ adịghị akọwapụta, ya mere ha gara n’ụlọ akwụkwọ dị iche iche.
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.explain: Degharịa ahịrị 1 n’asụsụ Bekee ka Ben bịa ebe Jisu nọ. Debe ụbọchị na oge otu ha dị.
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.prompt: Chee ebe Ben ga-eche mgbe ọ gụrụ “the library.” [1]
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye otu nkebiokwu ọzọ tupu ma ọ bụ mgbe “library” gasịrị iji kọwaa ebe ahụ (aha, ebe dị nso, wdg).
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.placeholder: Ị nwere ike ịmata ozugbo ụlọ akwụkwọ library nke ọ bụ?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị debere ụbọchị na oge nke ahịrị mbụ otu ha dị?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ben ọ ga-achọ ịjụ ọzọ mgbe ọ gụsịrị ya?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Azịza kọwara ebe ahụ n’ụzọ abụọ ma kpebie ebe a ga-ezukọkwa.

x-e-e4-08.title: Ònye bụ “she”?
x-e-e4-08.goal: Chọta nghọtahie nke pronoun kpatara, degharịa ya nke ọma site n’ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ aha ma ọ bụ okwu ozugbo.
x-e-e4-08.material:
'Hana zigara Jisu ozi ederede: "Mina told Sora that she has the glue."

Ihe Mina kwuru n'ezie bụ "Sora, you bring the glue." (Sora, you bring the glue.) Ma echi ya n'klaasị nka, ọ nweghị onye wetara glue.'
x-e-e4-08.thinking.0: Ịchọta mmadụ niile nke pronoun nwere ike ịzo aka na ha
x-e-e4-08.thinking.1: Ịkọwa ihe mere aghọtaghị ji eme
x-e-e4-08.thinking.2: Idozi ya ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị okwu na-enweghị aghọtaghị
x-e-e4-08.prereq.0: Okwu ndị bụ isi dị ka she, he, na told
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ mmadụ niile 'she' nwere ike ịzo aka na ha n'ahịrị okwu Hana.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.hint.0: Gụọ ole aha na-apụta n'ahịrị okwu ahụ.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta aha ụmụ nwanyị niile na-abịa tupu she.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.a: Hana bụ onye dere ahịrị okwu ahụ. Lelee ma aha ya na-apụta n'ime ahịrị okwu ahụ.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ onye na-abịa tupu 'told' n'ahịrị okwu ahụ.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.c: Onye na-abịa mgbe 'told' gasịrị nwekwara ike ịbụ 'she'.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ onye natara ozi ederede. Lelee ma aha ahụ na-apụta n'ime ahịrị okwu ahụ.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.explain: N'"Mina told Sora that she has the glue.", she nwere ike ịbụ Mina ma ọ bụ Sora. Hana na Jisu anaghị apụta n'ahịrị okwu ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na Jisu gụọ ya dị ka Mina, ọ ga-eche na Mina na-ebu ya.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.prompt: Dee ọzọ ahịrị okwu Hana n'asụsụ Bekee ka o doo anya na Sora ga-ebute glue. Ejila 'she'.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ cheta na ọ na-agbagwoju anya n'ihi na e nwere mmadụ abụọ 'she' nwere ike ịzo aka na ha.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.hint.1: Nwaa iji aha kama 'she', ma ọ bụ dee kpọmkwem ihe Mina kwuru n'ime akara okwu.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: O doro anya na e nwere naanị otu onye ga-ebute glue?
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Enweghị ihe nwere ike ịgbagwoju mmadụ ọzọ, dị ka pronoun dị ka 'she' ma ọ bụ 'her'?
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ọ nwere otu ihe pụtara dị ka ihe Mina kwuru na mbụ (Sora na-ebute ya)?
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza dị mma jiri okwu na-adịghị ozugbo na 'to bring'.

x-e-e4-09.title: Otu ọnọdụ ahụ, mmadụ abụọ dị iche
x-e-e4-09.topic: Idee n'ụzọ dị iche nye enyi na onye nkụzi
x-e-e4-09.goal: Dee otu ọnọdụ ahụ n'ụzọ dị iche, dị ka ozi ederede nye enyi na dị ka email nye onye nkụzi.
x-e-e4-09.material: E nwere omume ikwu Bekee n'ụlọ akwụkwọ n'ụtụtụ Satọde. Ma ị pụghị ịga n'ihi na ị na-aga njem ya na ezinụlọ gị n'ụbọchị ahụ. Dee n'asụsụ Bekee ozi ederede iji gwa enyi gị Jisu na email nye onye nkụzi gị Ms. Kim.
x-e-e4-09.thinking.0: Ịgbanwe ekele na ụda dabere n'onye na-anata ya
x-e-e4-09.thinking.2: Ịkewa arịrịọ dị mma na ụda na-adịghị mma
x-e-e4-09.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dị ka can't, sorry, na trip
x-e-e4-09.s.s1.prompt: Dee ozi ederede ị ga-eziga enyi gị Jisu n'ahịrị okwu Bekee otu ma ọ bụ abụọ. Gwa ya na ị pụghị ịga na ihe kpatara.
x-e-e4-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ị nwere ike ịmalite site na 'Hey' ma ọ bụ 'Hi', dị ka ị na-agwa enyi okwu.
x-e-e4-09.s.s1.hint.1: Buru ụzọ dee ahịrị okwu na-ekwu na ị pụghị ịga, wee gbakwunye ihe kpatara.
x-e-e4-09.s.s1.selfAssess.0: Ụda ahụ dị jụụ, dị ka ị na-agwa enyi okwu?
x-e-e4-09.s.s1.selfAssess.1: Ị dere ma na ị pụghị ịga ma ihe kpatara?
x-e-e4-09.s.s1.selfAssess.2: Ị gbakwunyere ozi ọzọ ọ bụla ị chọrọ (dị ka ịjụ ihe omume ahụ gbasara)? (nhọrọ)
x-e-e4-09.s.s1.modelNote.1: Azịza dị jụụ nke ọbụna kwuru nzukọ na-esote.
x-e-e4-09.s.s2.prompt: Ugbu a dee email nye Ms. Kim n'asụsụ Bekee. Malite site n'ekele, ma gwa ya ọnọdụ gị n'ụzọ dị mma.
x-e-e4-09.s.s2.hint.0: Malite ahịrị mbụ site na 'Dear ...,' ma ọ bụ 'Hello ...,'.
x-e-e4-09.s.s2.hint.1: Nwaa ịgbakwunye otu 'Sorry' ọzọ n'ihe i dere maka enyi gị, ma ọ bụ kwụsị site na 'Thank you'.
x-e-e4-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị malitere site na Dear ma ọ bụ Hello ma jiri aha ọkwa maka onye nkụzi gị?
x-e-e4-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: E nwere okwu dị mma dị ka 'Sorry' ma ọ bụ 'Thank you'?
x-e-e4-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ụda ahụ dị iche nke ọma na ihe i dere nye enyi gị?
x-e-e4-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza jụrụ n'ụzọ dị mma ihe a ga-amụ.

x-e-e4-10.topic: Idee n'ụzọ dị iche nye enyi na onye nkụzi
x-e-e4-10.title: Ịziga onye nkụzi ozi ederede e dere nye enyi
x-e-e4-10.goal: Chọta akụkụ nke ozi ederede nye enyi nke na-adabaghị onye nkụzi, ma dee otu ọnọdụ ahụ ọzọ ka o dabara onye nkụzi.
x-e-e4-10.material:
'Ozi ederede e zigara enyi Jisu (e dere ya dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

"Hey! I'm sick lol. Can't come 2 school 2morrow. Gimme the homework pls!"

(Site n'ụzọ, a na-agụ 2morrow dị ka 'tu-morrow', ụzọ mkpụmkpụ ide tomorrow.) Ị chọrọ iziga onye nkụzi gị otu ọdịnaya ahụ site n'email.'
x-e-e4-10.thinking.0: Ịchọta okwu ndị na-adabaghị onye na-anata ya
x-e-e4-10.thinking.1: Idebe ọnọdụ ahụ (ihe kpatara) ma gbanwee naanị ụda
x-e-e4-10.prereq.0: Ihe sick, homework, na tomorrow pụtara
x-e-e4-10.prereq.1: Otu esi agụ mkpụmkpụ okwu ozi ederede
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ akụkụ niile a ga-edozi mgbe a na-eziga onye nkụzi ozi ederede a.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.hint.0: Gụọ ya n'olu dara ụda dị ka ị na-agwa onye nkụzi okwu.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee iche, otu n'otu, mkpụmkpụ okwu, okwu ndị a na-ekwu n'ụzọ pụrụ iche, na otu esi arịọ.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.a: Ihe kpatara ịrịa ọrịa bụ ọnọdụ ị kwesịrị ịgwa onye nkụzi kwa. Chee ma a ga-agbanwe ya ma ọ bụ debe ya.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.b: Tụnyere eziokwu na onye na-anata ya bụ onye nkụzi na mmetụta nke okwu a.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.c: Chee ma iji ọnụọgụ kama okwu dabara ederede e zigara onye nkụzi.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.d: Lee ma otu esi arịọ dabara onye nkụzi.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.explain: 'lol', '2 school 2morrow' e mere ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ site n'ọnụọgụ, na 'Gimme ... pls!' bụ otu ndị enyi si agwa ibe ha okwu, ya mere a ga-edozi ha maka onye nkụzi. Ihe kpatara ịrịa ọrịa ('I'm sick') bụ ọnọdụ a ga-edebe.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.prompt: Dee ọzọ otu ọdịnaya ahụ n'asụsụ Bekee dị ka email nye Ms. Kim. Malite site n'ekele, ma gụnye na ị na-arịa ọrịa, na ị pụghị ịbịa echi, na arịrịọ ka e gwa gị ọrụ ụlọ.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.hint.0: Debe dị ka ọ dị akụkụ (ọnọdụ ahụ) ị na-ahọghị n'nzọụkwụ 1.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.hint.1: Gbanwee 'Gimme the homework' ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị okwu na-arịọ, dị ka 'Could you please ...?'.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị malitere site n'ekele dabara onye nkụzi?
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị wepụrụ mkpụmkpụ okwu na okwu pụrụ iche nke enyi niile?
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ọnọdụ (ịrịa ọrịa) ma arịrịọ (ọrụ ụlọ) ka dị?
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza nke ọbụna kwuru ịnweta ya site n'enyi.
